# Warner Dental

> Family, cosmetic, and restorative dentistry in Rigby, Idaho, led by
> Dr. Cory Warner, DDS. A small, relationship-focused practice. Accepting new patients.

## Dentist
Dr. Cory Warner, DDS: Creighton University School of Dentistry, 2022 (cum laude).
Grew up in Rigby.

## Services
- Checkups and cleanings: exams, digital x-rays, oral cancer screening, fluoride and sealants
- Family dentistry for kids, teens, and adults (children's fluoride included at no charge)
- Restorative: tooth-colored fillings, crowns, bridges, root canals, extractions, dentures and partials
- Cosmetic: esthetic (full-coverage) crowns; internal whitening for a single dark tooth; external whitening
- Implant restorations: implant crowns, implant bridges, implant-supported dentures
- Braces and clear aligners for teens and adults, including top-only or bottom-only treatment
- Emergency care: toothaches, broken teeth, dental injuries, with same-day priority when possible

## Insurance
Accepts most dental insurance plans, including Delta Dental. The office helps patients understand benefits and estimate costs before treatment.
